message: @@index([name(sort: Asc)]) on model "User" is named "User_name_idx", as is @@index([name]) on model "User". Prisma 6 refuses this: "The given constraint name `User_name_idx` has to be unique in the following namespace: on model `User` for indexes and unique constraints. Please provide a different name using the `map` argument."

@@index([phone]) on model "Contact" and @@index([email]) on model "User" are both named "by_contact" in collection "User". MongoDB cannot hold two indexes with one name in a collection. Give one of them another name with `map`.
